subject: Azure co-sell clearinghouse: Partner Center referral triage & account reconciliation
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@microsoft.com>, acme-strategic@acme-logistics.com
Cc: partnercenter-ops@microsoft.com
Date: 2026-08-12T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Azure co-sell clearinghouse: Partner Center referral triage & account reconciliation

Hi team — looping everyone so we can clear this referral into Partner Center and make sure field seller alignment + account ownership are reconciled before the co-sell kick.

Quick context: Microsoft routed a Partner Center referral for Acme Logistics (ref ID PC-ACME-237). Attached is the latest account roster we pulled from HubSpot and our internal account map (ACME_account_map_v2.xlsx). At a high level we need to: 
- Confirm the Microsoft field seller (which Alicia flagged) and the Microsoft co-sell contact in Partner Center.
- Reconcile which Redwood AE owns the relationship in HubSpot so we don’t duplicate outreach.
- Ensure Partner Center referral is accepted by the correct Beachhead contact at Acme (not the procurement alias).

Requested next steps (small asks, please):
1) Alicia / Partner Center: confirm referral ID and send the Partner Center invite link to our ops inbox (partnercenter-ops@microsoft.com is cc'd).
2) Lauren: please review the attached roster and mark the HubSpot owner column — I left a few blank where we’re unsure.
3) Karthik: suggest a 30-minute triage sync with Acme + MS field seller tomorrow morning (your calendar + theirs).
4) Rishi: once we have owner mapping, can you open the HubSpot ticket and tag the co-sell opportunity RDW-AZ-4267 and add the referral evidence artifact?

Goal: accept the referral in Partner Center and have owners confirmed by end of week so we can schedule an intro with Acme and MS field seller.

Attachments: ACME_account_map_v2.xlsx (account ownership columns), CoSell_clearinghouse_notes_20260812.pdf (notes template)

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0126

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@microsoft.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Thanks Vanessa — I pulled the referral and sent the Partner Center invite to partnercenter-ops@microsoft.com (screenshot attached). Referral ID PC-ACME-237 is live and the MS field seller is Marcus Hayes (marcus.hayes@microsoft.com). He’s happy to join the intro.

A few notes from my side:
- Partner Center will only accept a referral owner that matches the partner identity (please confirm the Redwood GTM contact as a named person).
- For speedy processing, please provide the ACME contact that should receive the intro (avoid procurement aliases).
- I’ve added the Partner Center acceptance link here: https://partnercenter.microsoft.com/referrals/PC-ACME-237

Forwarding the invite screenshot and Partner Center link — happy to jump on the triage call.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Azure Strategic GTM, Microsoft
Alicia.Gomez@microsoft.com

- Thu 8/13 10:00-10:30 PT
- Thu 8/13 15:00-15:30 PT

— Acme Logistics (on behalf of Ana)

4) Artifacts uploaded: CoSell_clearinghouse_notes_20260812.pdf, ACME_account_map_v2.xlsx (updated).
